chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله granted the paternal grandmother, the father’s mother, one-sixth while her son was alive; and he granted the maternal grandmother, the mother’s mother, one-sixth while her daughter was alive.

key_terms.الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأَبِ: the paternal grandmother, meaning the father’s mother
key_terms.الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأُمِّ: the maternal grandmother, meaning the mother’s mother
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Prophet’s authority as the source of this ruling

ai.seo_question: Does a grandmother inherit one-sixth if her son or daughter is still alive?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on inheritance shares for grandmothers. It reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله assigned one-sixth to both the paternal grandmother and the maternal grandmother, even when the intermediate child linking them to the deceased was still alive.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5626 - Al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) granted the paternal grandmother (the father's mother) one-sixth of the inheritance while her son was alive, and he granted the maternal grandmother (the mother's mother) one-sixth while her daughter was alive."
